items.en: Good morning everyone. Thank you for joining this quarterly yield review.
items.zh: 各位早安，感謝各位參加本次季度良率檢討會議。

items.en: I am Jerry from the device engineering team, and I will cover the WW32 excursion today.
items.zh: 我是元件工程部的 Jerry，今天由我說明 WW32 的良率異常事件。

items.en: Before we start, please feel free to stop me at any point if something is unclear.
items.zh: 開始之前，若有任何不清楚的地方，隨時可以打斷我。

items.en: The goal today is to agree on the containment scope and the release date.
items.zh: 今天的目標是就圍堵範圍與放行日期取得共識。

items.en: I will walk you through four parts: the issue, the analysis, the actions, and the schedule.
items.zh: 我會分四個部分說明：問題、分析、對策、時程。

items.en: The presentation should take about fifteen minutes, and we will leave ten minutes for questions.
items.zh: 簡報大約十五分鐘，另外保留十分鐘給提問。

items.en: Let me start with a quick summary, and then I will go into the data.
items.zh: 我先做個快速摘要，接著再進入資料細節。

items.en: Sort yield trended up by 2.3 points after the fix was implemented in WW32.
items.zh: 修正措施在 WW32 導入後，sort yield 上升了 2.3 個百分點。

items.en: The x-axis shows the work week, and the y-axis shows the sort yield in percent.
items.zh: 橫軸是工作週，縱軸是 sort yield 的百分比。

items.en: The red line is the excursion limit, and the shaded band is the normal range.
items.zh: 紅線是異常界限，陰影帶是正常範圍。

items.en: Yield dropped sharply in WW32 and recovered gradually over the following three weeks.
items.zh: 良率在 WW32 急遽下滑，接下來三週逐步回復。

items.en: As you can see on this wafer map, the failures are concentrated at the wafer edge.
items.zh: 從這張晶圓分佈圖可以看到，失效集中在晶圓邊緣。

items.en: If we drill down by tool, all failing lots came from the same furnace.
items.zh: 若按機台深入細看，所有失效批次都來自同一台爐管。

items.en: Edge die account for about eighty percent of the total fail count.
items.zh: 邊緣晶粒約占總失效數的百分之八十。

items.en: The difference between the two groups is statistically significant at the ninety-five percent level.
items.zh: 兩組之間的差異在百分之九十五信賴水準下具統計顯著性。

items.en: Please note that the last data point is preliminary and covers only two lots.
items.zh: 請注意最後一個資料點是初步數據，只涵蓋兩個批次。

items.en: The trial split recovered the yield to 94.1 percent, compared with 91.8 percent for the control.
items.zh: 試產分組把良率拉到 94.1%，對照組是 91.8%。

items.en: The root cause is a slow drift in chamber pressure on furnace F02.
items.zh: 根本原因是 F02 爐管腔體壓力的緩慢漂移。

items.en: The drift stayed inside the alarm limit but moved outside the qualified process window.
items.zh: 這個漂移仍在警報界限內，卻已超出認證過的製程窗口。

items.en: Cross-section analysis confirmed a thinner tunnel oxide at the die edge.
items.zh: 剖面分析確認晶粒邊緣的穿隧氧化層偏薄。

items.en: This finding is consistent with the read-disturb signature we saw at wafer sort.
items.zh: 這項發現與我們在 wafer sort 看到的讀取干擾特徵相符。

items.en: We reproduced the failure by running a split at the drifted pressure.
items.zh: 我們以漂移後的壓力做分組實驗，成功重現了失效。

items.en: We ruled out a package issue because the same failure appeared before assembly.
items.zh: 我們排除了封裝問題，因為同樣的失效在封裝前就出現了。

items.en: Tool commonality analysis pointed to one furnace in every failing lot.
items.zh: 機台共通性分析指出每個失效批都經過同一台爐管。

items.en: To be precise, the mechanism is confirmed, but the trigger of the drift is still under investigation.
items.zh: 精確地說，機制已經確認，但造成漂移的觸發原因仍在調查中。

items.en: As immediate containment, all sister lots were put on hold on 12 August.
items.zh: 作為立即圍堵，所有同期批已於 8 月 12 日扣留。

items.en: We added a temporary screening step before final test to protect shipments.
items.zh: 我們在終測前加了一道臨時篩選，以保護出貨。

items.en: The alarm limit will be tightened from eight percent to three percent, with automatic tool shutdown.
items.zh: 警報界限將從 8% 收緊到 3%，並加上機台自動停機。

items.en: The change takes effect from WW35 on all furnaces of the same type.
items.zh: 此變更自 WW35 起適用於所有同型爐管。

items.en: Containment stays in place until the fix is verified on three consecutive lots.
items.zh: 圍堵措施會持續到修正措施在連續三個批次上驗證通過為止。

items.en: We also applied the same check to the other furnace types and found no similar drift.
items.zh: 我們也把同樣的檢查橫向展開到其他型號爐管，沒有發現類似漂移。

items.en: That is a fair question. Let me give you the data we have so far.
items.zh: 這是個合理的問題，我先說明目前手上的資料。

items.en: I do not have that number with me. I will confirm it and send it by Friday.
items.zh: 這個數字我手邊沒有，我確認後於週五前寄給您。

items.en: Let me make sure I understand your question correctly. You are asking about the shipped material, right?
items.zh: 我確認一下我是否正確理解您的問題，您問的是已出貨的部分，對嗎？

items.en: We believe this will not recur because the tool now shuts down automatically when the limit is crossed.
items.zh: 我們認為不會再發生，因為機台現在一旦超出界限就會自動停機。

items.en: That point is outside the scope of today's review, but I am happy to follow up offline.
items.zh: 這一點超出今天檢討的範圍，但我很樂意會後個別追蹤。

items.en: To summarize, the mechanism is confirmed, the fix is in production, and yield is back to baseline.
items.zh: 總結：機制已確認、修正措施已導入量產、良率已回到基準水準。

items.en: The next milestone is the verification result, which we will share in WW36.
items.zh: 下一個里程碑是驗證結果，我們會在 WW36 分享。

items.en: Thank you for your time. I am happy to take any remaining questions.
items.zh: 感謝各位的時間，若還有問題我很樂意回答。

items.en: I will send the slides and the action items right after this call.
items.zh: 會後我會立刻把投影片與待辦事項寄給大家。
